_readme: Machine-rebuild environment schema (2026-08-05, enterprise-assessment idea 6, vault/research/enterprise-assessment-ideas.md). Declares every OUTSIDE-REPO dependency Alex needs on a machine, so scripts/bootstrap.ps1 can prove a fresh restore complete instead of archaeology. TRACKED + public, so it carries NO secret paths: secret-file expectations are read at runtime from system/credentials-ledger.json (gitignored, existence-checked only, values never read). Probes are COMMAND NAMES (resolved via Get-Command), never arbitrary strings, so this file cannot inject shell. Rules that would drift if restated (scheduler jobs, skill junctions) point at their source of truth instead of copying it.

tools.restore: winget install Git.Git; then `git config --global core.longpaths true` (restore doc: clone with -c core.longpaths=true)
winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS - must be >= 22: the Recall Spine uses node:sqlite
winget install Python.Python.3.12 (vault_search FTS5 index, guide edits, hq_self_heal)
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, then /login interactively; CLI is PINNED (DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1), update by hand
winget install GitHub.cli; then `gh auth login` device flow (Shaheen authenticates; account alex-kiarash-ai)
winget install Gitleaks.Gitleaks - the pre-commit secret scan FAIL-OPENS without it, so a machine without gitleaks silently loses the commit-time secret wall
Git-bundled gpg.exe is what production uses (vault-backup.ps1 resolves these same fallback paths, in this order, before PATH); winget install GnuPG.GnuPG only if Git's copy is gone
winget install ImageMagick.ImageMagick (image-manipulation skill; Inno flags /VERYSILENT /TASKS=modifypath)
winget install Rclone.Rclone (vault-backup B2 second leg; INERT until Shaheen provisions B2, human-actions f1-b2-backup)
pip install openai-whisper (HQ voice-note transcription in the 05:00/08:00 lanes; lanes degrade gracefully without it)
uv tool install diagrammer (diagrammer skill; ~/.local/bin on PATH)

npm_globals.note: n8n-cli skill backend; env N8N_URL + N8N_API_KEY at runtime. NOT the unscoped npm package n8n-cli.

python_packages.note: the plain-English guide (identity doc) is edited via python-docx; Change-Propagation item 7 dies without it

junction_rule.note: Every subdir of target_dir must have a junction in link_dir (git checkout drops them). Repair: bootstrap.ps1 -RepairJunctions (cmd /c mklink /J - junctions need no admin; Git Bash ln -s silently COPIES on Windows, PS symlinks need elevation. Learned 2026-07-12.)

scheduler_rule.note: Task Scheduler jobs are DECLARED in the manifest and created by /cron-setup. bootstrap only reports missing PersonalOS-* tasks; it never creates them (recreation is /cron-setup's job so the wrapper flags stay canonical).

secret_files_rule.note: The gitignored ledger names where every credential lives. bootstrap existence-checks the FILE-type entries (local_path field, or a repo-relative path in `where`); values are never read or printed. A missing ledger on a fresh machine means the encrypted vault backup has not been restored yet - restore it first (vault/projects/recovery/vault-backup-plan.md).

ssh.note: ~/.ssh/config Host n8n -> the Hetzner box (key-only root). Backups, HQ ship, voice-note pulls all use the alias.

claude_settings.note: identity.md section 4: all four must be re-applied after a restore (interactive model default, sonnet-only fallback, auto-memory OFF, autoupdater OFF).

git_expectations.note: PUBLIC repo alex-kiarash-ai/personal-os; nightly 21:30 push needs the PAT in Windows Credential Manager (ledger id github-backup-pat).
